Motor control

Connect to begin.

A fresh Arm is required for each run. The tested configuration is limited to an 8% command and 1.5 seconds, with a nominal 1 A winding-current threshold. Keep the motor secured and remove the propeller. Stop also runs when this page loses focus, becomes hidden, or loses its heartbeat.

Motor power

J19 supplies motor power; J1 supplies data. For a new power connection, set SW4 OFF, request 9 V, then turn SW4 ON.

Firmware

Connect to identify the firmware.

Download BLDC firmware (.uf2)

For this RP2040 / MCT8329A board only. Set SW4 OFF, hold BOOTSEL while connecting J1 DATA, then copy the UF2 to RPI-RP2. Reconnect here afterward.

Status LED guide

Blue: logic on, motor power off. Amber: powered and disarmed. Flashing amber: armed, waiting for Start. Cyan: starting. Green: driver reports running with FG activity. Red: fault or supply not ready. Normal completion disarms; the rotor may briefly coast.
